sar.narrative: Customer C05423, holder of card C05423-K1, is the subject of this report. Between 2016-12-03 12:00 and 2016-12-03 12:30, 4 transaction(s) totalling $1,884.76 were made on the card online from device profile 'Windows |  | chrome 63.0 | ': $457.09 (3509526, 2016-12-03 12:00), $492.56 (3509535, 2016-12-03 12:06), $455.25 (3509563, 2016-12-03 12:22), $479.86 (3509576, 2016-12-03 12:30). Every amount sat just below $500 and the purchases were placed minutes apart, a pattern consistent with deliberately staying under an authorisation threshold. The activity is suspicious because: 4 online purchases within 30 minutes, each between $400 and $500 ($457.09, $492.56, $455.25, $479.86; total $1,884.76). It closely resembles earlier confirmed fraud cases CC-3748, CC-3841, CC-3907. The bank has recommended blocking and reissuing the card, placing linked cards under monitoring where applicable, and retaining transaction, device, and investigation records as supporting documentation.
